events.event_name: CHANEL COCO MADEMOISELLE: A Special Event
events.what_it_is: A public fragrance experience celebrating COCO MADEMOISELLE CRUSH ABSOLU, with café-inspired seating, personalized fragrance discovery, the broader COCO MADEMOISELLE line, makeup and on-site shopping.
events.what_is_free: Admission and the fragrance-discovery experience are free. The event page also describes complementary hair and body products to experience; retail purchases are optional.
events.caveats: Current sources state that the event is free and open to the public. Appointments are recommended, but walk-ins are explicitly welcome, so advance booking is optional rather than required. Normal venue capacity still applies.
events.practical_notes: September 11 noon–7 PM; September 12–13 10 AM–7 PM; September 18 noon–7 PM; September 19–20 10 AM–7 PM. Use CHANEL's appointment page if you want a reserved time, but walk-in access is also advertised.

events.what_it_is: A two-day public pop-up for Estée Lauder's Glimmer Eau de Parfum with fragrance discovery, street treats and promotional gifts.
events.what_is_free: Public admission, fragrance discovery, street treats and promotional gifts are advertised. Specific gift quantities are not guaranteed.
events.caveats: NYC Plugged currently describes the event as open to the public and does not publish an advance RSVP or approval requirement. Promotional gifts and treats may be inventory-limited.
events.practical_notes: Friday, September 11 from 12:30–7 PM and Saturday, September 12 from 11 AM–7 PM at 711 Greenwich Street.

events.address: Saint Coffee, 201 7th Ave, New York, NY 10011
events.what_it_is: A Fashion Week coffee stop at Saint Coffee with a preview of White House Black Market's fall collection.
events.what_is_free: Current event listings advertise complimentary coffee and black-and-white cookies, plus a signature WHBM shirt to take home while available.
events.caveats: Current sources describe this as open to the public with no RSVP or host-approval step. The event ends at 1 PM on September 11, so it is only useful for users who can arrive before closing; promotional items may run out.
events.practical_notes: Friday, September 11 from 8 AM–1 PM at Saint Coffee, 201 Seventh Avenue.
